sentences.text: The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Mummineni Sudheer Kumar

Writ Petition No.29658 of 2023
Order:
Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for the respondents.

2. It is the case of the petitioner that the respondents have initiated the land acquisition proceedings under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short, 'the Act, 2013') by issuing a preliminary notification under Section 11 (1) of the Act, 2013.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Thereafter, a declaration under Section 19 (1) of the Act, 2013 was made vide proceedings No.J/A/712/2015, dated 04.06.2020, wherein lands admeasuring 804 sq. yards and 744 sq. yards were notified in the names of sister-in-law and mother of the petitioner, though the petitioner is also having interest in the said property.

In the light of the representation stated to have been submitted by the petitioner, the respondents have passed an Award in the names of the sister-in-law and mother of the petitioner for the land admeasuring 516 sq. yards only vide Proceedings No.G/204/2017, dated 30.06.2023, and the Proceedings No.G/204/2017, dated 22.08.2023.
However, no Award is passed in respect of the remaining extent of 516 sq. yards for which the petitioner is entitled for payment of compensation.
3. According to learned counsel for the petitioner, the sister- in-law and the mother of the petitioner,
namely

, Ponaganti Deepika, W/o. Raju, and Ponaganti Padma, W/o. Sampath Rao, whose names were notified in the declaration, dated 04.06.2020, have no objection for payment of compensation in respect of the remaining extent of 516 sq. yards in favour of the petitioner.
Therefore, the petitioner claims to have submitted a representation, dated 17.10.2023, before respondent Nos.2 and 3 and the said representation is still pending consideration.
Hence, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks indulgence of to consider the said representation, dated 17.10.2023, submitted by the petitioner and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law.

4. A perusal of the said representation, dated 17.10.2023, shows that the same was acknowledged by the office of respondent Nos.2 and 3.
5.

In the light of the same, the writ petition is disposed of directing respondent Nos.2 and 3 to consider the representation, dated 17.10.2023, submitted by the petitioner and pass appropriate orders thereon in accordance with law as expeditiously as possible at any rate within a period of two months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order, after affording an opportunity of personal hearing to the petitioner.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Miscellaneous Petitions, if any, pending in this writ petition shall stand closed.
